title: SQL Server: a capture instance named in another case reports LOG_TRUNCATED

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, case-insensitive database, one run

symptom: The capture instance was named in a different case from its table: the update FAILED with INGESTION_GATEWAY_CDC_LOG_TRUNCATED ("CDC log truncated, full refresh required").
cause: Not isolated: the case-sensitive database case wasn't run.
effect: The update fails until a full refresh.
fix: Full refresh; check the instance name in cdc.change_tables.
